About the Scholarship

NOHA is the Erasmus Mundus joint master in international humanitarian action, coordinated from the University of Groningen through the NOHA network. For the 2027 intake the Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline is 15 December 2026 at 23:59 GMT, while the central application deadline for all ordinary candidates is 1 April 2027 and non-EU applicants have until 1 July 2027.

OpportunityNOHA – Erasmus Mundus Master in International Humanitarian Action
HostNOHA Network (University of Groningen)
LocationGroningen (multi-country mobility), Netherlands
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline15 December 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

NOHA is the Erasmus Mundus joint master in international humanitarian action, coordinated from the University of Groningen through the NOHA network. For the 2027 intake the Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline is 15 December 2026 at 23:59 GMT, while the central application deadline for all ordinary candidates is 1 April 2027 and non-EU applicants have until 1 July 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • The reference programme in humanitarian studies with a 30-year network
  • Three-tier deadlines: scholarship (15 December 2026), central (1 April 2027), non-EU (1 July 2027)
  • Mobility across European partner universities with humanitarian placement options
  • Graduates join UN agencies, the Red Cross movement, NGOs and donor institutions

Who Should Apply

Graduates and humanitarian professionals from any discipline with documented interest in humanitarian action; work experience in the sector strengthens scholarship files.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus grant covers participation costs and provides a monthly allowance for selected students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Use the NOHA apply portal; scholarship applicants must submit by 15 December 2026 (23:59 GMT) to enter the grant round. Key deadline information: 15 December 2026 (23:59 GMT, Erasmus Mundus scholarship round). Central deadline for all candidates: 1 April 2027; non-EU applicants: 1 July 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About NOHA Network (University of Groningen)

The NOHA network, anchored at the University of Groningen, delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in International Humanitarian Action through European partner universities and humanitarian partners worldwide.

Official website: https://www.nohanet.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
